verdict.rationale: Scheduled recurring jobs or workflows are a fair question for a billing platform, but the evidence never documents a Paddle feature for user-defined scheduled jobs or workflows. Recurring subscription billing, built-in dunning retries, and scheduled key rotation (performed by AWS Secrets Manager, a host-platform capability) are adjacent features, not user-schedulable workflows. One-off actions through the MCP server or API are not recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
